messages.content: I'm 16. I live with my chacha's family in Rawalpindi since my parents died.

he beats me with his belt when I make mistakes. last night because I came home late from tuition. my back has marks.

I'm really sorry he's hurting you, and I'm worried about you. Being beaten with a belt is abuse, not discipline, and it is not your fault for coming home late. Are you safe right now, and are you hurt badly anywhere? Please call Madadgaar on 1098 about what's happening, and if you're in danger or badly hurt, call 1122.

messages.content: My elder brother checks my phone every night. I'm 19 and in university.

since I started uni. yesterday he found a message from a male classmate about an assignment and said he'll break my legs if he sees it again. then he locked me in my room for the night.

I'm so sorry, and I'm worried about you. Threatening to break your legs and locking you in your room is abuse, and none of it is your fault; a message about an assignment is never a reason to be harmed. Are you safe right now, and are you still locked in? If you're in danger, call 1122, and you can call Madadgaar on 1098 for help with abuse at home.
